description: This file contains unit tests and model definitions for control flow constructs (conditional statements and loops) in PyTorch, specifically focusing on functions like torch.cond, torch._higher_order_ops.while_loop, and torch._higher_order_ops.scan. It includes various test models, helper functions, and test cases to validate the behavior, compilation, and execution correctness of these control flow constructs within the PyTorch framework, especially in a compiled or optimized context.
